## Thematic Map — Fraud Detection

```
Fraud Detection
├── Detection Paradigm
│   ├── Graph-based (GNN, network analysis)
│   │   ├── Homogeneous graphs (transaction-to-transaction)
│   │   └── Heterogeneous graphs (account–merchant–device)
│   ├── Tabular / feature-based
│   │   ├── Velocity & aggregation features
│   │   ├── Behavioral biometrics
│   │   └── Device fingerprinting
│   └── Unsupervised / anomaly detection
│       ├── Isolation Forest
│       └── Autoencoder-based
├── Modeling Approach
│   ├── Classical (logistic regression, SVM)
│   ├── Ensemble (XGBoost, LightGBM, random forest)
│   └── Deep learning (GNN, LSTM, transformer)
├── Operational Constraints
│   ├── Real-time (<100 ms) vs. batch
│   ├── Explainability requirements (GDPR, FCRA)
│   └── Class imbalance handling
└── Evaluation
    ├── Metrics (AUC-PR, F1, precision@recall)
    ├── Dataset construction & label noise
    └── Temporal train-test split
```
